ruleNotes.silence: 20ms RMS windows <= -50dBFS; flag leading >1.5s, trailing/internal >1.8s or >50% silent windows.
ruleNotes.level: Flag RMS <-35 or >-6dBFS and DC offset magnitude >0.05.
ruleNotes.clipping: Flag samples with |value| >=32760 above 0.1%, or above 0.01% with a consecutive run >=8 samples.
ruleNotes.duration: For >=30 spoken letters/numbers: flag <2.7 or >14 chars/s, or outside 0.5–1.8 times the same-speaker median.
ruleNotes.interpretation: Flags identify suspicious signals for review; they do not prove incorrect words or assess pronunciation/naturalness.
